text: dsh-grok-build-auth-bridge 是面向 DSH Web 的 Grok Build 模型接入插件。它作为 Host Cordis bundle 注册 provider 配置，通过 DSH 凭据服务同步本机 Grok CLI 会话中的短期访问令牌，并在启动、定时及请求前检查凭据。插件创建 grok-build 路由，连接 Grok 4.6 与 Grok Build 订阅代理，适合希望在 DSH 中使用现有 Grok Build 登录的用户。需要本机 Grok Build CLI、已登录会话以及 DSH 的 pi-ai adapter；模型请求发送到 Grok 代理。

dsh-grok-build-auth-bridge connects a Grok Build session to DSH Web. It adds a Grok 4.6 provider route and syncs its access token through DSH credentials at startup, periodically, and before requests. Requires the official Grok CLI and a logged-in session; requests use the Grok Build proxy.
想在 DSH Web 里使用已有的 Grok Build 订阅登录
让 DSH 自动同步本机 Grok CLI 的登录凭据
Use my existing Grok Build subscription as a model provider in DSH
dsh-grok-build-auth-bridge 的功能「Grok 模型路由」：在 DSH 设置中添加 grok-build provider，将 Grok 4.6 请求接入 Grok Build 订阅代理。
dsh-grok-build-auth-bridge 的功能「会话凭据同步」：读取本地 Grok 会话并按到期时间检查访问令牌；启动、定时和对应模型请求前同步到 DSH 凭据服务。
dsh-grok-build-auth-bridge 使用 Grok Build 订阅代理处理 Grok 4.6 模型请求，请求发送到 cli-chat-proxy.grok.com。

dsh-grok-build-auth-bridge README · dsh-grok-build-auth-bridge：Reuse the official [Grok Build](https://github.com/xai-org/grok-build) CLI subscription login in [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

This package is a **Host Cordis bundle**. It reads Grok Build's local session, delegates refresh-token handling to the official `grok` binary, synchronizes only the short-lived access token into DSH's credential service, and provisions a pi-ai route for the Grok Build subscription proxy.
dsh-grok-build-auth-bridge README · dsh-grok-build-auth-bridge：It does not contain, upload, or commit any token.

dsh-grok-build-auth-bridge README · Requirements：- Node.js 22.19 or later
- DSH with the `dsh-llm-pi-ai` adapter
- The official Grok Build CLI installed and logged in:

```bash
grok update
grok login
grok models
```

The login must produce `${GROK_HOME:-~/.grok}/auth.json`.

dsh-grok-build-auth-bridge README · Install：Run this on each device after logging in with Grok Build:

```bash
npx --yes github:shaomingbo/dsh-grok-build-auth-bridge#v0.1.0
```

The installer adds the package and its Cordis bundle to `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json`, then runs `pnpm install`. Restart `dsh web` afterward.

The plugin creates this model route through DSH settings without replacing existing providers:

- Provider: `grok-build`
- Model: `grok-4.6`
- Protocol: OpenAI Responses
- Endpoint: `https://cli-chat-proxy.grok.com/v1`

dsh-grok-build-auth-bridge README · How it works：Using the official CLI for refresh preserves Grok Build's file-locking, team-principal parameters, refresh-token rotation handling, and sleep/suspend safeguards. The bridge never writes `~/.grok/auth.json` itself.

The route sends the subscription proxy headers required by the official client, including `X-XAI-Token-Auth`, model override, client mode, and the locally installed Grok version from `~/.grok/version.json`.

dsh-grok-build-auth-bridge README · Environment overrides：| Variable | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DSH_GROK_AUTH_PATH` | `${GROK_HOME:-~/.grok}/auth.json` | Exact Grok auth file |
| `DSH_GROK_VERSION_PATH` | `${GROK_HOME:-~/.grok}/version.json` | Installed Grok version metadata |
| `DSH_GROK_BIN` | `${GROK_HOME:-~/.grok}/bin/grok` | Official CLI executable |
| `DSH_GROK_AUTH_SCOPE` | auto-detected | Exact auth.json scope for multiple-session files |
| `DSH_GROK_CREDENTIAL_REF` | `GROK_BUILD_ACCESS_TOKEN` | DSH credential reference |
| `DSH_GROK_PROVIDER_ID` | `grok-build` | DSH provider route ID |
| `DSH_GROK_CLIENT_VERSION` | version.json value; fallback `1.0.3` | Proxy version header override |
| `DSH_GROK_REFRESH_MARGIN_MS` | `300000` | Refresh margin before expiry |
| `DSH_GROK_SYNC_INTERVAL_MS` | `600000` | Background synchronization interval |

dsh-grok-build-auth-bridge README · Environment overrides：If you override the provider ID or credential reference after the route has already been created, update or remove the old route in DSH's Models settings.

dsh-grok-build-auth-bridge README · Security notes：- `~/.grok/auth.json` contains a refresh token. The bridge refuses to read it on Unix if group or other users have access; use `chmod 600 ~/.grok/auth.json`.
- Only the short-lived access token is copied to `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` through the normal DSH credential service.
- The plugin never logs credential values or sends the refresh token anywhere.
- If `GROK_BUILD_ACCESS_TOKEN` is exported in the parent environment, it shadows DSH's writable credential store. Unset it before starting DSH.

dsh-grok-build-auth-bridge README · Current model scope：The proxy requires `x-grok-model-override` at the provider-header level, while DSH provider headers are shared by every model on that route. Version `0.1.0` therefore exposes one verified route, `grok-4.6`. Additional Grok models can be added as separate provider routes in later releases.

dsh-grok-build-auth-bridge README · Development：```bash
npm install
npm test
npm run check
```

The primary-source research behind the bridge is in [`docs/research.md`](docs/research.md).
